repos.name: ur5e-teaching-controllers
repos.one_line: ros2_control effort controllers for a simulated UR5e: joint-space tracking (PID, PID with RNEA feedforward, computed torque) on Pinocchio or KDL dynamics, gravity-compensated hand guiding with a runtime payload model, and damped-least-squares TCP jogging.
repos.stack: C++ for the control loop (controllers, dynamics backends); Python for orchestration and plots. ROS 2 Lyrical, ros2_control, Gazebo Jetty, Pinocchio, KDL.

hero.alt: Still from the hero GIF: a simulated UR5e in Gazebo switching between trajectory tracking and gravity-compensated hand guiding

repos.name: pointcloud-constrained-planning
repos.one_line: Keep-the-cup-upright constrained planning for a simulated UR5e through a shelf that MoveIt 2 only knows from an octomap built live from a simulated RGB-D camera, benchmarked against a pipeline written directly on OMPL, Pinocchio and coal.
repos.stack: C++ for the planning path (benchmark nodes, constraint builder, the direct pipeline); Python for launch, aggregation and plots. ROS 2 Lyrical, MoveIt 2 (MoveItCpp), OMPL, Pinocchio, coal, Gazebo Jetty.

hero.alt: Still from the hero GIF: the same shelf query planned without a constraint (left) and with the keep-upright constraint (right)

repos.name: sim-demo-to-policy
repos.one_line: A MuJoCo pick-and-place task on a Franka Panda: scripted demonstrations recorded as LeRobot datasets, ACT and a small from-scratch spatial-softmax BC policy trained on a laptop CPU, and an evaluation harness with held-out seeds, a failure taxonomy and confidence intervals.
repos.stack: Python only: the imitation-learning stack is Python. MuJoCo, LeRobot, PyTorch; CPU only.

hero.alt: Still from the hero GIF: the scripted expert and the smallbc policy on a held-out seed, and smallbc on a shifted-box seed
